title: Welding Technician Basic
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: WELDING TECHNICIAN BASIC: CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT
outcomes: The student will be able to set up and operate manual and semi-automatic welding and cutting equipment commonly used in the welding industry.
The student will be able to perform basic layout and fabrication to construct welded metal parts common to the welding industry.
The student will be able to read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, basic welding codes and American Welding Society Weld Symbols.
The student will be able to work as part of a team and perform skills in a professional, ethical manner.
The student will be able to perform welding and cutting operations in the flat, horizontal, vertical up and down, and in the overhead fabrication positions using GMAW, SMAW, FCAW, GTAW, OAC, and PAC.
The student will be able to develop the skills needed to qualify as a certified welder under the AWS D1.1 Structural Welding Code.

notes: Catalog prints codes with a hyphen (WELD-121, WELD-150); these match closed-list WELD 121 and WELD 150.
WELD-120 (Welding Technology 1, 7 units) is required in the catalog but is not in the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
'pre-apprentice roles' taken from the program description as the only career named; reviewer may judge whether it counts as a career.
